Resolves #21565

A required field in the alert state leaves it as soon as its value is filled, whether the text was typed, pasted or autofilled. `Text#afterSetValue` now toggles `neo-empty-required`, beside `neo-is-dirty`, where `isEmpty()` reads the value the class describes. `afterSetInputValue` no longer toggles it from the value before the input. In `apps/form`, a pasted invalid email now shows its error in the invalid color.

Evidence: L3 (a unit spec and a browser e2e on the real form app, both red on `dev` and green at head, plus computed colors from headless Chromium) → L3 required (AC-2 is a rendered color). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/form/field/TextAlertState.spec.mjs`. "one input event that fills the field leaves the alert state" is red on `dev`. The clearing, programmatic and initial-state arms guard the move. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `FormApp.spec.mjs` "a pasted email that is not valid leaves the empty-required alert state, so its error shows as invalid", red on `dev`. Outside-CI color: `apps/form` in neo-dark, `fill('jane.doe@')` then Tab. The error is `rgb(255, 171, 64)` on `dev` `5cb81df00a` and `rgb(255, 138, 128)` here, the same color typing gives. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/form/` (186 specs) and `test/playwright/e2e/form/` (`FormApp`, `ValidationExample`, 10 specs). Also green locally at head. |

## Deltas from ticket

- AC-2 is also CI-covered: a `FormApp.spec.mjs` arm asserts the class on the real input path. The ticket asked only for an outside-CI receipt.

- e2e: 1 failed, `Received string: "neo-textfield label-inline neo-empty-required neo-is-dirty neo-has-content neo-invalid neo-is-touched"`.

At head, both pass: 4 of 4 unit arms, and the e2e arm (`-g "pasted email"`, 1 matched).
